_meta.notes: Older form variant (April 5 / seven-days-before-primary / September 15 / seven-days-before-general interim options, plus a separate top-row 'Office' box which is blank). The Office Sought entry is a scrawled two-letter abbreviation read as 'DA' (District Attorney) at LOW confidence, and the District Number box holds the word 'County' - recorded verbatim as printed. Lines 1 and 4 Column A are a hand-drawn slashed zero (an oval with a line through it) = 0. Line 2 Column A is '300' with slashed zeros and no cents; Line 6 restates it as '300' with a raised '00'. Cents on Lines 3/5/7 are raised underlined superscripts (1045 with a raised 79). Column B is blank throughout. Arithmetic is consistent (1045.79 - 300.00 = 745.79). Clerk listing calls this the '2007 Summary Report'; the form checks the YEAR-END box and is dated 1/25/08.
